thread:
maria_g: Heads-up: v3->v4 cutover hit a snag for a couple big tenants. Idea: stage by traffic profile (size/qps) not strict time windows. Thoughts?

alex_k: sounds good. Profile could be p50 tokens, qps, and embedding volume. Smaller profiles move faster.

jonathan_r: prefer single opt-in header + central routing table. Keeps gateway logic simple. e.g. `X-Cohort: v4-early` or `X-Migrate: v4`

samir: add telemetry flag so we can detect silent regressions. Metrics: per-tenant error-rate, p99 latency, token-regression rate, cache hit-rate.

maria_g: propose tolerance budget: if latency >1.5x or token-loss >0.5% sustained for 1h, auto-fallback tenant.

alex_k: sketch cohorts config:
```
cohorts:
 - name: tiny
   selector: qps<20 && avg_tokens<256
   window: 12h
 - name: small
   selector: qps<100
   window: 48h
 - name: large
   selector: qps>=1000
   window: 168h
fallback:
 latency_mul: 1.5
 token_regression_pct: 0.5
 eval_interval: 1h
```

jonathan_r: put routing & fallback in control plane so Dedicated/Private can opt-in. Expose API for overrides.

samir: will add per-tenant regression alerts + cluster rollup. Also track prefix-cache hit-rate and model-variant fallbacks.

maria_g: owners: @alex_k routing, @jonathan_r control-plane API, @samir telemetry. Need runbook for manual rollback + forced fallback.

alex_k: test plan: replay traces locally, 3 heavy-token canaries, then cohort waves. Gate each wave by tolerance checks.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by maria_g: `deploy cohort-router v2` — staging:started :rocket:

jonathan_r: question: runtime shim to translate legacy fields vs gateway-only? Shims ease clients but add runtime path cost.

maria_g: leaning gateway-only for hosted; provide small shim lib for private installs (opt-in). Avoid perf tax on hot path.

samir: add telemetry tag for shim usage to measure and plan removal.

alex_k: I'll open the RFC PR with config + rollout playbook. Canary next Tue AM unless objections.

maria_g: no objections. I'll write rollback runbook and post to #release-war-room. Sync Wed to finalize canary list. :thumbsup:
